svg.title: Nyquist pulse and eye diagram
svg.desc: Four panels compare the overall raised-cosine pulses, normalised spectra and BPSK eye diagrams for roll-off factors 0.25 and 1.

cc:Work.dc:title: Nyquist pulse and eye diagram
cc:Work.dc:description: Raised-cosine pulses, corresponding spectra and superimposed BPSK signal segments for two roll-off factors.
